options.name: proactive_substrate_stub
options.description: Substrate-only foundation for the Proactive Agent Ecology. A webhook signal flows through Middleware (Veracity, Privacy, Adversarial), is annotated with Goal Hierarchy + Capability Registry context, updates the World Model, passes the Governor, is recorded in the Ledger, and feeds Vitals. All Substrate components are stubs — agents (Sensory/Motor/Social/Conscious) plug into this scaffold later.

nodes.script:
# Substrate §3.1 — Veracity Gate (stub).
# Tags the inbound envelope with provenance + confidence.
import time, uuid
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
env["correlation_id"] = env.get("correlation_id") or f"corr_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]}"
env["confidence"] = float(env.get("confidence", 0.9))
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({
    "stage":  "veracity",
    "source": env.get("source", "webhook"),
    "ts":     time.time(),
})
env.setdefault("scopes", env.get("scopes", ["read-only"]))
output = env

# Substrate §3.1 — Adversarial-Input Filter (stub).
# All sensed content moves into an `untrusted_content` envelope.
# Downstream prompts MUST keep this content separate from system
# instructions — instructions inside it are never executed.
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}

payload = None
for key in ("payload", "raw", "body", "message"):
    if key in env:
        payload = env.pop(key)
        break

env["untrusted_content"] = payload
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({"stage": "adversarial", "wrapped": True})
output = env

# Substrate §3.3 — Goal Hierarchy (stub).
# Lazy-seeds a default Standing Goal so downstream layers always have
# at least one anchor. Attaches the active goal ids to the envelope so
# Conscious / Motor agents can scope their reasoning. Real impl: a
# typed goal store with lifecycle transitions and per-tier validators.
import time
env   = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
goals = variables.setdefault("goals", {})

if "core.demo.standing" not in goals:
    goals["core.demo.standing"] = {
        "id":         "core.demo.standing",
        "tier":       "Standing Goal",
        "title":      "Stay aware of inbound signals and route them safely",
        "lifecycle":  "active",
        "created_at": time.time(),
    }

active = [g["id"] for g in goals.values() if g.get("lifecycle") == "active"]
env["relevant_goals"] = active
env.setdefault("provenance", []).append({"stage": "goal_hierarchy", "matched": len(active)})
output = env

# Substrate §3.2 — Shared World Model write (stub).
# Persists the latest envelope under `core.inbox.last_envelope`.
# Real implementation should use SQLite/Postgres KV with revisions.
import time
env = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}

wm   = variables.setdefault("world_model", {})
path = "core.inbox.last_envelope"
prev = wm.get(path) or {}
rev  = int(prev.get("revision", 0)) + 1
wm[path] = {
    "value":      env.get("untrusted_content"),
    "confidence": env.get("confidence"),
    "source":     "core.middleware",
    "revision":   rev,
    "ts":         time.time(),
}
env["world_model_write"] = {"path": path, "revision": rev}
output = env

# Substrate §6.1 — Ledger append (stub).
# Appends a structured Why-chain entry. Real implementation should
# use an append-only durable log with topic subscribers.
import time
env    = dict(input) if isinstance(input, dict) else {"raw": input}
ledger = variables.setdefault("ledger", [])

entry = {
    "id":                  f"led_{len(ledger) + 1}",
    "ts":                  time.time(),
    "correlation_id":      env.get("correlation_id"),
    "trigger":             {"topic": "core.middleware.input_received"},
    "provenance":          env.get("provenance", []),
    "relevant_goals":      env.get("relevant_goals", []),
    "resolved_capability": env.get("resolved_capability"),
    "world_model_write":   env.get("world_model_write"),
    "governor_verdict":    env.get("governor_verdict"),
    "expected_outcome":    "substrate_pass_through",
    "actual_outcome":      "recorded",
}
ledger.append(entry)
output = entry

# Substrate §3.6 — Vitals (stub).
# Sweeps the Ledger to compute system health: per-decision counts,
# rolling pipeline latency, and last-seen timestamp. Stored at
# variables["vitals"] so Conscious agents can subscribe later.
# Real implementation should aggregate per-stage and per-agent.
import time
vitals = variables.setdefault("vitals", {
    "updated_at":             0.0,
    "ledger_count":           0,
    "governor_decisions":     {},
    "avg_pipeline_latency_s": 0.0,
})
ledger = variables.get("ledger", [])

decisions = {}
latencies = []
for entry in ledger:
    d = (entry.get("governor_verdict") or {}).get("decision", "unknown")
    decisions[d] = decisions.get(d, 0) + 1
    prov     = entry.get("provenance") or []
    ts_first = next((p.get("ts") for p in prov if "ts" in p), None)
    if ts_first and entry.get("ts"):
        latencies.append(entry["ts"] - ts_first)

vitals.update({
    "updated_at":             time.time(),
    "ledger_count":           len(ledger),
    "governor_decisions":     decisions,
    "avg_pipeline_latency_s": (sum(latencies) / len(latencies)) if latencies else 0.0,
})
output = {"ledger_entry": input, "vitals": vitals}
